reviewScope: All effective source rows and retained fields mechanically compared against official XML, independent count/value summation and class eligibility; live official cover verification; independent fresh SEC submissions history and archive-date coverage checks; official table spot checks. No claim of individual human review of every row.
constraints: Historical reported Section 13(f) share positions as of 2026-06-30, observed through 2026-10-18. Never whole portfolio, total AUM, or legal ownership.
Share-view weights use only this filer/date eligible-share reported-value denominator 3378870771423 USD. Whole-dollar values, never legacy thousand-dollar scaling.

Retain source-row identity, class, reporting date, value, and manager-reference provenance. Same-security source rows may be grouped for display only with underlying rows recoverable; never multiply by manager-reference count.
No cross-filer deduplicated ownership or AUM aggregate. Source-reported discretion may overlap parent, fund, and manager layers.
Publish normalized factual fields and source links only; do not publish raw CUSIP/FIGI identifiers or the raw XML bundle.
The share view includes fund shares, depositary receipts, preferred shares and units, including funds with non-equity underlying assets; it is not common-stock-only.
Use verified reportingDate and filingDate in public UI. Do not display acceptedAt as independently resolved acceptance time; SEC API and filing index can differ.
Use September 22, 2026 RESTATEMENT only as effective rows; never add the August 7 original to it. Preserve both filing entries in the amendment ledger.
Preserve raw SH on GOLAR LNG NOTE row 4255, flag the explicit-debt/source-quantity conflict, and exclude it from share-view rows and denominator.
publicRightsScope: Confirmed factual normalized minimal fields, no proprietary security identifier values or document republication in the payload. This is dataset admission, not a blanket license/legal opinion.
